core_obligations: Statement (lines 1875-1879): in the quotient model M/approx of the term model, A is satisfied iff A is in Gamma*, for all sentences A.

Proof (lines 1880-1891): by induction on A, just as in the term-model Truth Lemma; the only case needing additional attention is the identity case A identified with (t = t'), carried in full: satisfaction iff the equivalence classes of t and t' coincide (definition of the quotient structure), iff t approx t' (definition of the class map), iff (t = t') is in Gamma* (definition of approx).
proof_roadmap: Cite the term-model Truth Lemma for the shared induction skeleton.
Carry the identity case through the three-link equality chain.
